content.text:
I added `(` and `)` keys; I have not run it in a browser. Traced by hand: `2 + ( 3 × 4 ) =` gives 14, `( 2 + 3 ) × 4 =` gives 20, and nested groups work. Chose: each `(` saves the pending outer operation; `)` finishes the inner one and hands its result back. `=` closes any groups still open. A stray `)` is ignored.
Why: this keeps the stated left-to-right, no-precedence rule both inside and outside groups, so `2 + ( 3 ) × 4 =` is still 20.
Rejected: treating `5 (` as `5 × (`, and a separate expression parser. I added no check because the logic is DOM-bound, not a pure function.
